package com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.venuealloc.impl.service;

import com.huawei.bsp.log.OssLog;
import com.huawei.bsp.log.OssLogFactory;
import com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.venuealloc.impl.mapper.ScenesMgrDBMapper;

import org.joda.time.DateTime;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/**
 * 场景任务锁管理实现类
 *
 * @since 2026-03-01
 */
@Component
public class SceneTaskLockServiceImpl {
    private static final OssLog LOGGER = OssLogFactory.getLog(SceneTaskLockServiceImpl.class);

    @Autowired private ScenesMgrDBMapper scenesMgrDBMapper;

    private static final String[] LOCK_NAMES = {
        "tocAllocEva.SceneTaskCreateLock", "tocAllocEva.SceneCreateLock"
    };

    private static final int TIMEOUT_MINUTES = 5;

    private static final int NORMAL_LOCK_FLAG = 0;

    /**
     * 异常锁处理定时任务入口
     */
    public void runTask() {
        try {
            for (String lockName : LOCK_NAMES) {
                String threshold = DateTime.now().minusMinutes(TIMEOUT_MINUTES).toString("yyyyMMddHHmmss");
                int rows = scenesMgrDBMapper.clearExpiredLocks(lockName, threshold);
                if (rows != NORMAL_LOCK_FLAG) {
                    LOGGER.warn("A deadlock has been detected and automatically released! Lock name: {}", lockName);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.error("An exception occurred when deleting expired locks", e);
        }
    }
}

package com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.impl;

import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSON;
import com.huawei.bsp.log.OssLog;
import com.huawei.bsp.log.OssLogFactory;
import com.huawei.bsp.remoteservice.exception.ServiceException;
import com.huawei.bsp.roa.common.HttpContext;
import com.huawei.bsp.roa.util.restclient.RestfulParametes;
import com.huawei.bsp.roa.util.restclient.RestfulResponse;
import com.huawei.cloudsop.sys.util.i18n.ResourceUtil;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.business.intent.IndexManagerConstants;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.business.intent.KnowledgeQuery;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.business.intent.KnowledgeRecommendsRsp;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.business.intent.KnowledgeRsp;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.business.intent.RetrieverReq;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.business.intent.RetrieverReqBuilder;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.delegate.AlarmKnowledgeSearchServiceDelegate;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.diagnose.enums.IncidentConstant;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.model.AlarmDiagQueryParam;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.model.AlarmKnowledgeResult;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.model.AlarmKnowledgeResultWithCase;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.model.AlarmQueryParam;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.model.QueryParam;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.util.rest.RestConstant;
import com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.util.rest.RestUtil;
import org.apache.commons.collections4.CollectionUtils;
import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import static com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.diagnose.enums.IncidentConstant.LLM_GENERATE;
import static com.huawei.i2000.dvaiagentservice.diagnose.enums.IncidentConstant.USER_EDIT;

/**
 * 告警案例检索
 *
 * @author w00430116
 * @since 2025/5/20
 */
@Component
public class AlarmKnowledgeSearchServiceDelegateImpl implements AlarmKnowledgeSearchServiceDelegate {

    private static final OssLog LOGGER = OssLogFactory.getLogger(AlarmKnowledgeSearchServiceDelegateImpl.class);

    public static final String RETRIEVER_KLG_URL = "/rest/naie/rag/v1/retriever";

    private static final float ALARM_RERANK_THRESHOLD = 0.0F;

    private static final Pattern ALARM_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("ALM-(\\d+)");

    private KnowledgeRecommendsRsp getKnowledgeRecommendsRsp(HttpContext context, QueryParam queryParam)
            throws ServiceException {
        RetrieverReq retrieverReq = RetrieverReqBuilder.getRetrieverReq(queryParam);
        String param = JSON.toJSONString(retrieverReq);
        RestfulParametes restfulParametes = new RestfulParametes();
        restfulParametes.setRawData(param);
        RestfulResponse knowledgeRsp = RestUtil.sendRestRequest(context.getHttpServletRequest(),
                RestConstant.RESTFUL_METHOD_POST, RETRIEVER_KLG_URL, restfulParametes, null);
        if (knowledgeRsp == null || knowledgeRsp.getStatus() != RestConstant.STATUS_OK) {
            LOGGER.error("[knowledgeSearch] query knowledge error");
            throw new ServiceException("[knowledgeSearch] query knowledge error");
        }

        return JSON.parseObject(knowledgeRsp.getResponseContent(), KnowledgeRecommendsRsp.class);
    }

    @Override
    public AlarmKnowledgeResult alarmKnowledgeSearch(HttpContext context, AlarmQueryParam alarmQueryParam)
            throws ServiceException {
        QueryParam queryParam = new QueryParam();
        AlarmKnowledgeResult knowledgeResult = new AlarmKnowledgeResult();
        if (StringUtils.isEmpty(alarmQueryParam.getAlarmId()) && StringUtils.isEmpty(alarmQueryParam.getAlarmName())) {
            return knowledgeResult;
        }

        if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(alarmQueryParam.getAlarmId())) {
            queryParam.setQuery("ALM-" + alarmQueryParam.getAlarmId());
        } else {
            queryParam.setQuery(alarmQueryParam.getAlarmName());
        }

        queryParam.setIndexName(IndexManagerConstants.KNOWLEDGE_INDEX);
        KnowledgeRecommendsRsp knowledgeRecommendsRsp = getKnowledgeRecommendsRsp(context, queryParam);
        for (KnowledgeRsp knowledge : knowledgeRecommendsRsp.getRecommends()) {
            if (knowledge != null && knowledge.getTitle() != null &&
                knowledge.getRerankScore() >= ALARM_RERANK_THRESHOLD && knowledge.getTitle().startsWith("ALM-")) {
                String alarmId = alarmQueryParam.getAlarmId();
                if (StringUtils.isNotEmpty(alarmId) && !knowledge.getTitle().contains(alarmId)) {
                    LOGGER.warn("Skip knowledge, alarmId:{}, knowTitle:{}", alarmId, knowledge.getTitle());
                    continue;
                }
                knowledgeResult.getKnowledgeLabel().addAll(knowledge.getLabel());
                knowledgeResult.getSourceResult().add(knowledge.getSource());
                knowledgeResult.getKnowledgeResult().add(transformSource(KnowledgeQuery.extractKnowledgeData(knowledge)));
                knowledgeResult.setAlarmId(extractAlarmId(knowledge.getTitle()));
                break;
            }
        }

        if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(knowledgeResult.getKnowledgeResult())) {
            LOGGER.info("alarmId:{}, name:{}, assembleAlarmKnowledge",
                    alarmQueryParam.getAlarmId(), alarmQueryParam.getAlarmName());
            return assembleAlarmKnowledge(knowledgeRecommendsRsp.getRecommends());
        }

        return knowledgeResult;
    }

    public AlarmKnowledgeResult assembleAlarmKnowledge(List<KnowledgeRsp> recommends) {
        AlarmKnowledgeResult knowledgeResult = new AlarmKnowledgeResult();
        for (KnowledgeRsp knowledge : recommends) {
            knowledgeResult.getKnowledgeLabel().addAll(knowledge.getLabel());
            knowledgeResult.getSourceResult().add(knowledge.getSource());
            knowledgeResult.getKnowledgeResult().add(transformSource(KnowledgeQuery.extractKnowledgeData(knowledge)));
        }

        return knowledgeResult;
    }

    public String transformSource(String knowledge) {
        String replaceSource = ResourceUtil.getMessage(IncidentConstant.USER_ARCHIVE);
        return knowledge.replace(LLM_GENERATE, replaceSource).replace(USER_EDIT, replaceSource);
    }

    /**
     * 告警知识和案例查询
     *
     * @param context             context
     * @param alarmDiagQueryParam 请求入参
     * @return 告警知识及案例
     * @throws ServiceException 异常
     */
    @Override
    public AlarmKnowledgeResultWithCase alarmKnowledgeSearchWithCase(HttpContext context,
                                                                      AlarmDiagQueryParam alarmDiagQueryParam)
            throws ServiceException {
        QueryParam queryParam = new QueryParam();
        queryParam.setIndexName(IndexManagerConstants.ALL_ENTITY_INDEX);
        List<AlarmQueryParam> alarmList = alarmDiagQueryParam.getAlarmList();
        AlarmKnowledgeResultWithCase knowledgeResult = new AlarmKnowledgeResultWithCase();
        knowledgeResult.setAlarmKnowledge(new AlarmKnowledgeResult());
        knowledgeResult.setAlarmCase(new AlarmKnowledgeResult());

        if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(alarmList)) {
            return knowledgeResult;
        }
        AlarmKnowledgeResult alarmKnowledge = new AlarmKnowledgeResult();
        for (AlarmQueryParam alarm : alarmList) {
            queryParam.setQuery("ALM-" + alarm.getAlarmId() + " " + alarm.getAlarmName());
            // 查询告警知识
            KnowledgeRecommendsRsp knowledgeRecommendsRsp = KnowledgeQuery.getEntityKnowledgeRecommendsRsp(context, queryParam);
            for (KnowledgeRsp knowledge : knowledgeRecommendsRsp.getRecommends()) {
                // 过滤告警知识
                if (alarm.getAlarmId().equals(extractAlarmId(knowledge.getTitle()))) {
                    alarmKnowledge.getKnowledgeLabel().addAll(knowledge.getLabel());
                    alarmKnowledge.getSourceResult().add(knowledge.getSource());
                    alarmKnowledge.getKnowledgeResult().add(KnowledgeQuery.extractKnowledgeData(knowledge));
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        knowledgeResult.setAlarmKnowledge(alarmKnowledge);
        return knowledgeResult;
    }

    private String extractAlarmId(String knowledgeTitle) {
        Matcher matcher = ALARM_PATTERN.matcher(knowledgeTitle);
        if (matcher.find()) {
            return matcher.group(1);
        } else {
            return "";
        }
    }
}

package com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.dao;

import com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO;
import com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper;
import com.huawei.wax.utils.exception.ServiceException;

import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/**
 * 报告模板Dao
 *
 * @since 2025-10-09
 */
@Component
public class ReportTemplateDao extends AbstractDao {
    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ReportTemplateDao.class);

    /**
     * 插入新模板
     *
     * @param reportTemplatePO 报告模板数据模型
     * @throws ServiceException 异常
     */
    public void insert(ReportTemplatePO reportTemplatePO) throws ServiceException {
        if (reportTemplatePO == null) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            ReportTemplateMapper mapper = getMapper(ReportTemplateMapper.class);
            mapper.insert(reportTemplatePO);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.error("insert failed. {}", e.getMessage());
            throwServiceException(LOGGER, "insert template");
        }
    }

    /**
     * 根据模板ID查询
     *
     * @param templateId 模板ID
     * @return 报告模板数据模型
     * @throws ServiceException 异常
     */
    public ReportTemplatePO selectByTemplateId(String templateId) throws ServiceException {
        try {
            ReportTemplateMapper mapper = getMapper(ReportTemplateMapper.class);
            return mapper.selectByTemplateId(templateId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.error("selectByTemplateId failed. {}", e.getMessage());
            throwServiceException(LOGGER, "select template by templateId");
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * 根据模板ID删除
     *
     * @param templateId 模板ID
     * @throws ServiceException 异常
     */
    public void deleteByTemplateId(String templateId) throws ServiceException {
        if (StringUtils.isEmpty(templateId)) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            ReportTemplateMapper mapper = getMapper(ReportTemplateMapper.class);
            mapper.deleteByTemplateId(templateId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOGGER.error("deleteByTemplateId failed. {}", e.getMessage());
            throwServiceException(LOGGER, "delete template by templateId");
        }
    }

    /**
     * 根据模板ID更新
     *
     * @param templateId 模板ID
     * @param reportTemplatePO 报告模板数据模型
     * @throws ServiceException 异常
     */
    public void updateByTemplateId(String templateId, ReportTemplatePO reportTemplatePO) throws ServiceException {
        if (StringUtils.isEmpty(templateId)) {
            return;
        }
        ReportTemplateMapper mapper = getMapper(ReportTemplateMapper.class);
        mapper.updateByTemplateId(templateId, reportTemplatePO);
    }

    /**
     * 更新状态为已发布
     *
     * @param reportTemplatePO 报告模板数据模型
     * @throws ServiceException 异常
     */
    public void updateStatusWithDeployed(ReportTemplatePO reportTemplatePO) throws ServiceException {
        if (reportTemplatePO == null) {
            return;
        }
        ReportTemplateMapper mapper = getMapper(ReportTemplateMapper.class);
        mapper.updateStatusWithDeployed(reportTemplatePO);
    }

    /**
     * 更新状态为未发布
     *
     * @param reportTemplatePO 报告模板数据模型
     * @throws ServiceException 异常
     */
    public void updateStatusWithUndeployed(ReportTemplatePO reportTemplatePO) throws ServiceException {
        if (reportTemplatePO == null) {
            return;
        }
        ReportTemplateMapper mapper = getMapper(ReportTemplateMapper.class);
        mapper.updateStatusWithUndeployed(reportTemplatePO);
    }
}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <!-- 定义所有字段 -->
    <sql id="columns">TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS</sql>

    <!-- 插入单条记录 -->
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE (<include refid="columns"/>) VALUES
        (#{templateId},
         #{templateName},
         #{remark},
         #{version},
         #{createDate},
         #{creator},
         #{modifyDate},
         #{modifier},
         #{status},
         #{templateType},
         #{cover},
         #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <!-- 根据模板ID查询 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateId" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <!-- 根据模板ID删除 -->
    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <!-- 根据模板ID更新 -->
    <update id="updateByTemplateId" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            CREATEDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.createDate},
            CREATOR = #{reportTemplatePO.creator},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            STATUS = #{reportTemplatePO.status},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新状态为已发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新状态为未发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

</mapper>

</parameter>

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.simplifieddao.mapper.ReportTemplateMapper">

    <!-- 定义所有字段 -->
    <sql id="columns">TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS</sql>

    <!-- 插入单条记录 -->
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        INSERT INTO TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE (<include refid="columns"/>) VALUES
        (#{templateId},
         #{templateName},
         #{remark},
         #{version},
         #{createDate},
         #{creator},
         #{modifyDate},
         #{modifier},
         #{status},
         #{templateType},
         #{cover},
         #{catalogs})
    </insert>

    <!-- 根据模板ID查询 -->
    <select id="selectByTemplateId" resultType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        SELECT TEMPLATEID, TEMPLATENAME, REMARK, VERSION, CREATEDATE, CREATOR, MODIFYDATE, MODIFIER, STATUS, TEMPLATETYPE, COVER, CATALOGS
        FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </select>

    <!-- 根据模板ID删除 -->
    <delete id="deleteByTemplateId">
        DELETE FROM TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </delete>

    <!-- 根据模板ID更新 -->
    <update id="updateByTemplateId" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET TEMPLATENAME = #{reportTemplatePO.templateName},
            REMARK = #{reportTemplatePO.remark},
            VERSION = #{reportTemplatePO.version},
            CREATEDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.createDate},
            CREATOR = #{reportTemplatePO.creator},
            MODIFYDATE = #{reportTemplatePO.modifyDate},
            MODIFIER = #{reportTemplatePO.modifier},
            STATUS = #{reportTemplatePO.status},
            TEMPLATETYPE = #{reportTemplatePO.templateType},
            COVER = #{reportTemplatePO.cover},
            CATALOGS = #{reportTemplatePO.catalogs}
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新状态为已发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithDeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Deployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

    <!-- 更新状态为未发布 -->
    <update id="updateStatusWithUndeployed" parameterType="com.huawei.ncedatacubeplus.datasmartcubeservice.model.ReportTemplatePO">
        UPDATE TBL_NL2REPORT_CONVERSATION_REPORT_TEMPLATE
        SET STATUS = 'Undeployed'
        WHERE TEMPLATEID = #{templateId}
    </update>

</mapper>
